other_failure_modes.name: Feature engineering data leakage
other_failure_modes.description: Distribution-based feature engineering (like frequency encoding, target encoding, or ranking) is applied to the concatenated train and test sets before splitting. This leaks the distribution of the test set into the training features.

summary: The agent builds a robust pipeline with three well-configured gradient boosting models, but introduces a few data science flaws. It leaks test set information by calculating categorical frequency encodings on the combined train/test dataset. Furthermore, it ignores the temporal nature of the data by using random cross-validation, and performs a naive ensemble using hardcoded arbitrary weights.
